title: NNTP reader: per-session failure rate limiter on AUTHINFO
description: reader/session/lifecycle.rs:275-304: no limit on failed AUTHINFO attempts per session. Fix: add a per-session failure counter. After 5 consecutive failures, close the connection with 400 (no explanation). Reset on success. Do not add delays — bcrypt already adds ~100ms per attempt at the configured cost factor; delays on top of that are not necessary and complicate the implementation. The counter lives in session state, no shared mutable state needed.
